semantics.keyDistribution: Every replica receives the same current Gateway-managed logical key in its per-call forms.list grant.
semantics.rotation: The Gateway replaces the logical key for subsequent grants; the plugin keeps no previous-key fallback, so cursors issued with the old key are rejected after rotation.
semantics.replicaFailure: Failure to redeem a cursor grant fails that forms.list call closed as storage_unavailable and does not affect another replica.
semantics.settingsRevisionBinding: Cursor claims are bound to site, schemaName, and equality filter, not to a settings revision; cursor signing keys are per-call grants, not ConfigApply settings.
semantics.tokenVersion: A token version other than the configured version is rejected as validation_failed.
